name: Index Writer
description: Write embedded chunks in bounded, validated, upserting batches; refuse a payload that does not fit the index before writing; and keep creation and destruction as separate, recorded operations.
install: No dependencies beyond core-types and vector-store-protocol. Copy with: ragkit add index-writer
missing_dependency_message: index-writer needs no package. If a write silently lands nothing, read the BatchReport rather than the return code: report.ok is False whenever any single item failed, and report.failures names each one.
